blocks.text:
This page is a **test of the free editor**. If you can read this on the live site, the editor, the repo, and Cloudflare are all connected.

Change this text in the editor, move a block, change a colour — then publish and watch this page change.
You cannot survive what you destroy.
The blocks on this page — heading, paragraph, formula, quote — are the building pieces. In the editor you can add more, delete them, and drag them into a new order.
